messages:
maya: Quick sync on the 'safety-net' for auto-fallback UX. Want a tiny, clear surface: mode, fallback %, triggers, and a replay sandbox button.

chris: +1. Make defaults conservative (5% canary). Show a small cost estimate when fallback is active.

linh: For auditability: emit a compact decision event with decision_id, policy_version, trigger_summary, and a link to the metric blob. Replay uses those blobs.

product_ana: Need plain-English explain view for support and a one-click export of the audit row. Also require justification for manual overrides.

ops-bot: docs snippet for override API:
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/rollouts/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"decision_id":"auto-1876543211-1","action":"route_canary","justify":"incident"}'

maya: UX note: surface an "oscillation warning" with suggested fixes (increase cooldown / widen thresholds). We'll iterate mockups.
